_about: Public-domain A. C. Gaebelein (Arno Clemens Gaebelein, 1861-1945) for the Word Hoard, printings dated before 1930 only: five Project Gutenberg texts (The Work of Christ, The Lord of Glory, Studies in Zechariah, Studies in Prophecy, The Prophet Ezekiel) and, from Internet Archive scans, eight of the nine volumes of The Annotated Bible (copyright 1913-1921; New Testament vol. 4 has no date and waits in _pending), expositions of Matthew, Acts, John, Genesis, Daniel, Joel and Revelation, and shorter books 1903-1927. Dispensationalist; veto point. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 18 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
